children.title: Configit Systems
children.description: A list of systems, owned by Configit

children.title: Configit Ace
children.description: Configit Ace is a product configuration platform that enables businesses to create, manage, and deliver complex product configurations across various sales channels.

children.title: Ace Configure
children.description: Ace Configure is the is the configuration module that exposes the configure API.

children.title: Ace Model
children.description: Ace Model is the model management module that allows authoring and management of product models.

children.title: Ace Configurator
children.description: Ace Configurator is a module within the Configit Ace platform that focuses on the configuration aspect, allowing users to define and manage product configurations effectively.

children.title: Configit Ace Thread
children.description: Configuration storage integrated with Ace Configure that allowes storing and retrieving configurations attached to session keys.

children.title: Client Systems
children.description: A list of systems, owned by Client

children.title: Client Configurator Page
children.description: A Web page that allows users to configure Client services using the Configit Ace platform. It creates configuration sessions in Ace Configurator and interacts with Ace Thread to retrieve configurations.

children.title: CW
children.description: An unknown system owned by Client, that may consume the Ace Configure API.

relations.comment: The Client Configurator page creates Configuration sessions in Ace Configurator and stores the session key.
The Client Configurator page retrieves configurations from Ace Thread using the session key.
The Client Configurator page may use the Ace Configure API to retrieve view information such as properties.
CW may consume the Ace Configure API to perform configurations.
Ace Configurator uses the Ace Configure component to handle configuration requests.
Ace Configurator uses the Ace Thread component to store and retrieve configurations.
Ace Configure relies on Ace Model for product models.
